post_title: Question about my dad's chemo schedule
author: dr_okafor
body: Oncology RN here. Post-infusion fatigue typically peaks around days 2-4. Gentle hydration and short walks can help, but please flag any fever over 38C to your care team promptly as it can signal neutropenia. Always check with your father's team before adding supplements.
